cfa_lead: The architecture you want, written as a contract. JGates never infers it: it checks what is in the file.
cfa_governed_reason: Governed mode: the rules are fixed by the policy {policy} and do not change here.
cfa_missing: There is no {file} yet. Create the file in the YAML tab to declare layers and rules.
cfa_map_lead: Arrows show allowed dependencies between neighbouring layers; the crossed arrow marks a pair that an enabled rule forbids.
cfa_rule_boundary: The component {component} can only depend on {allowed}.
cfa_rule_fan: Fan-in and fan-out limit in {layer}: in {fanIn}, out {fanOut}.
cfa_cov_off: No architecture adapter is enabled. Available: {tools}.
cfa_cov_none: No adapter in the project checks architecture: the rule will not be checked.
cfa_unresolved_none: No validation with architecture has run yet, so there is no graph to show.
cfa_unresolved_run: From the last run with architecture: {run}.
cfa_generated_lead: Generated from the rules in the last run, read-only. To change it, edit architecture.yml.
cfa_generated_none: No native configuration has been generated yet.
